messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick ping — prepping the materials handoff to Marketplace PMs next week. Need to align LMS learning path + the marketplace demo checklist.
Omar (SI Enablement): Good call. We should map modules to marketplace assets (tile, screenshots, short demo video).
Diego (Marketplace): FYI marketplace prefers a 90s promo video and 3 bullets for the tile. We can host the longer how-to on our docs page.
Cara (Solutions): For the LMS path, can we break the SI onboarding into: 1) Intro + sales positioning, 2) Hands-on deploy lab, 3) Troubleshooting + escalations, 4) Certification quiz.
Omar (SI Enablement): Yes — that's what pilots used. Suggest adding a short "marketplace deploy" micro-lab between 2 and 3 that shows publishing a test app to the marketplace.
Priya (Partnerships): Marketplace micro-lab sounds perfect. Diego, can marketplace provide a sandbox tile template?
Diego (Marketplace): I'll upload the template to /files/marketplace-tile-template.png and add a doc: https://marketplace.redwood.com/partner-tile-guidelines. Quick note: tile text max 140 chars.
Onboard Bot: Reminder: TASK-8132 created 1h ago 1Assign: Diego, Omar.
Omar (SI Enablement): We also need an approve flow for partner content before it goes live. Who signs off? Partnerships + Marketplace PM?
Priya (Partnerships): Partnerships signs off on messaging; Marketplace PM signs off on asset format. Final legal review for logos if partner requests co-branding.
Cara (Solutions): A practical ask from coaches: include a short troubleshooting checklist for marketplace deploy failures (common: missing IAM role, wrong env vars, KMS key access). Could be a 1-pager.
Diego (Marketplace): I'll draft a checklist. Can someone list the top 3 failure causes from pilot runs?
Omar (SI Enablement): From pilots: (1) partner didn't enable KMS key policy for our service principal (2) image size exceeded limit because debug artifacts weren't stripped (3) missing env var for redis URL causing start failures.
Priya (Partnerships): I'll add those to the checklist and create an "ASAP preflight" form partners fill 48h before handoff. That form should include KMS ARN, expected image size, and a contact for infra.
Onboard Bot: New artifact uploaded: /files/si-marketplace-preflight-form.docx
Cara (Solutions): For the certification quiz, let's make it adaptive: if a partner fails a module, surface remediation content and allow resubmission within 7 days. Less friction.
Omar (SI Enablement): Agreed. Also propose an intermediate "verified" badge for partners who complete labs with coach sign-off but haven't passed full cert. Good for marketplace listing as "verified with Redwood coach".
Diego (Marketplace): That badge idea could work as a secondary label on the tile. We need a graphic (40x40) and text string. Priya, can Partnerships own copy?
Priya (Partnerships): Yup I'll draft copy. Suggested copy: "Verified by Redwood: Hands-on enablement completed." Feedback welcome.
Cara (Solutions): Small logistics item: demo video recording 15min slot in the lab schedule. Please confirm if we should require closed captions for accessibility.
Diego (Marketplace): Yes, captions required for marketplace assets. We can auto-generate but partners should review accuracy.
Priya (Partnerships): Action items: 
- Diego: upload tile template + draft marketplace checklist by EOD Thu (1792180000)
- Omar: update LMS flow to include micro-lab and adaptive quiz rules by Mon (1792250000)
- Cara: produce troubleshooting 1-pager and demo recording guide by Fri (1792150000)
- Priya: create preflight form fields and badge copy; circulate for review by Wed (1792120000)
Onboard Bot: Tasks created: TASK-8132, TASK-8133, TASK-8134.
Omar (SI Enablement): I'll also add a "lab extension" booking option (60m) to the registration form for partners who need extra time.
Diego (Marketplace): Once we have the tile assets + short video, I can queue the marketplace listing process. Expect ~3 business days review.
Priya (Partnerships): Great. Let's reconvene next Tue 9am PT to confirm assets and sign-off. Adding calendar invite now.
Cara (Solutions): Thanks all, this should make the handoff much smoother. :white_check_mark:
